#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <regex>

using namespace std;

int maxOutsideWord(const string& text) {
    regex underscore("_");
    sregex_token_iterator iter(text.begin(), text.end(), underscore, -1);
    sregex_token_iterator end;
    int maxLen = 0;
    for (; iter != end; ++iter) {
        maxLen = max(maxLen, (int)iter->length());
    }
    return maxLen;
}

int countInsideWords(const string& text) {
    regex underscore("_");
    sregex_token_iterator iter(text.begin(), text.end(), underscore, -1);
    sregex_token_iterator end;
    int count = 0;
    for (; iter != end; ++iter) {
        if (!iter->empty()) count++;
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    bool openParenthesis = false;
    string sb;
    int maxOutSide = 0;
    int nbrInside = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            if (!openParenthesis) {
                maxOutSide = max(maxOutSide, maxOutsideWord(sb));
            }
            openParenthesis = true;
            sb.clear();
        } else if (c == ')') {
            openParenthesis = false;
            nbrInside += countInsideWords(sb);
            sb.clear();
        } else {
            sb += c;
        }
    }
    maxOutSide = max(maxOutSide, maxOutsideWord(sb));
    cout << maxOutSide << " " << nbrInside << endl;
    return 0;
}
